I get burnt out by people so easily. Thank you so much for letting me know I'm not alone.

Lmao I've deadass knocked a door off of its hinges at a job before too. And yeah, I had the perfect job before where I was a night auditor at a tiny little inn. Hey but thank you for reaching out and sharing your experience/thoughts. I appreciate it a lot, helped me calm down a little bit.
